data.title: Harbour Views
data.about:
Located in the beautifully crafted Dubai Creek Harbour, Emaar’s Harbour Views offer more than 750 homes with 1, 2, 3 bedrooms and penthouses.

51 floors of elegance within 2 towers nestled in the Creek Harbour, is the perfect place to find your new home. Wake up to the most mesmerising views of the Marina, Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai and the lush landscaped Gallery Park.

Residents of Harbour Views have access to the best amenities; luxury pool, podium amenities and more. It is located in the heart of the Island District.
